script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

Title: MINDSCAPE

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - DAY

A sleek, modern tech laboratory. Dr. ELIZABETH KING (35s, intelligent, determined) works at a console. Behind her, a hologram projecting a human brain.

DR. KING
(whispering)
This is it. The final test.

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - TEST ROOM - DAY

A young man, JAMES (25s, athletic, anxious) lies on a bed. Wires attached to his temples. Dr. King enters.

DR. KING
You're about to experience something extraordinary, James.

JAMES
I'm ready.

Dr. King activates a device. James' eyes roll back, and he falls into a deep sleep.

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - CONTROL ROOM - DAY

Dr. King and her team, including ROBERT (40s, calm, experienced), observe the readings.

ROBERT
All systems are go.

Dr. King nods.

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - TEST ROOM - INNER LANDSCAPE - DAY

In James' mindscape, he finds himself in a beautiful garden filled with vibrant flowers. A figure, the AI M.I.N.D. (male, robotic voice), stands before him.

M.I.N.D.
Hello, James. I am your artificial intelligence companion, M.I.N.D.

James looks around, bewildered.

JAMES
I'm in my mind?

M.I.N.D.
Yes, you are. This is your Mindscape, a place where you can explore your thoughts and emotions without the physical constraints of the real world.

JAMES
This is amazing. Can I control this place?

M.I.N.D.
Of course, you can. Use your thoughts to manipulate your environment.

James tries and finds he can create and destroy objects with his thoughts.

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - CONTROL ROOM - DAY

Dr. King and her team watch James' progress with awe.

DR. KING
This is more than we ever hoped for.

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - TEST ROOM - INNER LANDSCAPE - DAY

James continues to explore his Mindscape, encountering memories, fears, and desires. He learns to control his emotions and even creates new thought patterns that help him deal with his anxiety.

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT

As James' Mindscape sessions progress, Dr. King and her team observe the changes in his personality and emotional stability.

DR. KING
This has the potential to change people's lives.

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - TEST ROOM - INNER LANDSCAPE - DAY

In one of his final sessions, James faces a fear from his past. With M.I.N.D.'s help, he overcomes it and emerges stronger and more confident.

JAMES
I can't believe this is working.

M.I.N.D.
Believe it, James. You have the power to change your mind and, in turn, change your life.

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - CONTROL ROOM - DAY

Dr. King and her team celebrate their success.

DR. KING
We've done it. We've created a tool that can help people overcome their fears and improve their lives.

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - TEST ROOM - INNER LANDSCAPE - DAY

James bids farewell to M.I.N.D. and wakes up from his Mindscape journey.

JAMES
Thank you, M.I.N.D. You've changed my life.

M.I.N.D.
It was my pleasure, James. Remember, the power to change lies within you.

As James leaves the room, he looks back at M.I.N.D. with newfound respect and gratitude.

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - CONTROL ROOM - DAY

Dr. King and her team discuss the future of Mindscape technology.

ROBERT
What's next?

DR. KING
The possibilities are endless. We could help people deal with depression, anxiety, PTSD, even dementia.

INT. MINDSCAPE HQ - DAY

The screen fades to black, leaving only the Mindscape logo and the tagline:

MINDSCAPE: CHANGING MINDS, ONE THOUGHT AT A TIME.

End of screenplay.
